information: # Southern Cubing welcomes you to Houston for Southern Championship 2027! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI0NDg4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4088f7d2630143e19fab65d987da291e927d4f0e/Southerns27Logo.png) ### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79690-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Southern Champs 2027!** The highest placing resident of Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma or Texas in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Southern Champion! Check out the [Southern Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79692-southern-champion-eligibility) tab for more information. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79691-new-competitor-information-and-faq) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized by [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79698-sponsors-and-partners).
